phase4_deferred: Negative-control assertions and distinct unsupported generated claims are intentionally not judged until phase 4; there are no FP/TN/Precision/Recall/F1 results in phase 3.
limitations: Automated lexical/contextual evidence checking is not a substitute for a human or model verifying every predicate for all 1,024 source atoms.
The phase-2 eligible generated-claim ledger contains some document metadata/bare reference fragments; do not use those to assert source coverage; revisit their eligibility during phase 4/5.
Conservative E1/E0 FN judgments may include semantically valid cross-file entailments missed by the bounded matcher; all candidates and exact line locations are retained for correction.
Automatically accepted E2 entailments are provisional until independently challenged in phases 4 and 5.
Atomization review flags from phase 1 are carried to phase 5 without changing R in phase 3.
